related_clauses.quote: 3. SECURITY DEPOSIT. The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) on or before the date of possession. The deposit shall be refunded within thirty (30) days of the Licensee vacating the Premises, after deducting any amounts towards unpaid licence fee, damages and painting charges.

LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT (SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT)

This Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 between Mr. A. Sharma, the Licensor, and Ms. B. Rao, the Licensee, for the premises at 12 MG Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka (the "Premises").
5. MAINTENANCE. The Licensee shall bear minor repairs. Structural repairs shall be the responsibility of the Licensor.
